name: Solenne Atelier SynthForm Gala Formal Set
description: A commissioned formal set — structured jacket in smoke-grey brocade with variable-length sleeves that telescope via hidden snap-track to fit limbs up to 1.8x human standard, paired with high-waisted formal trousers in matching fabric with an adaptive waistband. The jacket's back panel is architecturally cut to accommodate torso geometries that deviate significantly from human baseline. Silk-analog pocket square and coordinating cufflinks are included. This is what synthetic personhood looks like with a budget.
functionality: Telescoping snap-track sleeves, adaptive waistband, architectural back panel for non-human torso geometry.
what_it_says: I am not approximating humanity — I am exceeding it.
story_hooks: This suit was made for a synthetic's personhood hearing — the synthetic won, and now the suit is famous.
A corponation exec wants to buy it off the synthetic's chassis mid-event; the price offered is offensive.
